newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline barges ease on aggressive selling.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline barges ease on aggressive selling.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices continued to ease despite some recovery in other oil products on Tuesday, dealers said.

Eurograde gasoline was down around $3-4 a tonne, with one lot of refinery material traded early at $219 fob Rotterdam. Storage material was $1-2 under this level, but bids were no higher than $214 at around lunchtime.
Selling was fairly aggressive with the barge market seen well supplied and inland demand thin.
Cargo prices were also softer but falls were cushioned by tighter prompt supply.
